title: BugRepro
shortSummary: Track a defect from its initial report through reproduction attempts and proposed fixes.
problem: Track a defect from its initial report through reproduction attempts and proposed fixes.
architecture: A React client has a browser-storage demo mode. The full application uses an Express API and MongoDB.
decisions: Try a checkout defect, draft a report, log a reproduction attempt, and vote on a proposed fix.
highlights: Try a checkout defect, draft a report, log a reproduction attempt, and vote on a proposed fix.
outcome: Browser checks covered duplicate recovery and persistence. Live MongoDB was outside the verified demo.
constraints: The examples use sample data and are designed for local review.
demoSetup:
cd client
npm ci
npm run demo

title: Constraint Engine
shortSummary: Find a valid route through a grid and inspect the rules that fired after each move.
problem: Find a valid route through a grid and inspect the rules that fired after each move.
architecture: The same browser rules engine powers the route search and a live sandbox with editable rules.
decisions: Change the starting energy or move limit and compare a successful route with an unsatisfiable one.
highlights: Change the starting energy or move limit and compare a successful route with an unsatisfiable one.
outcome: The project handoff reports 41 Vitest tests and desktop and mobile browser checks.
constraints: The examples use sample data and are designed for local review.

title: Debug AI
shortSummary: Inspect a runtime error, trace the stack, and review a proposed fix.
problem: Inspect a runtime error, trace the stack, and review a proposed fix.
architecture: A TypeScript client calls an API. The default mode applies deterministic rules to produce labeled simulated results.
decisions: Load the React or Python example and inspect the highlighted stack frames before reviewing its suggested fix.
highlights: Load the React or Python example and inspect the highlighted stack frames before reviewing its suggested fix.
outcome: Three API integration tests and browser checks passed in the handoff. The live provider path remains untested.
constraints: The examples use sample data and are designed for local review.
demoSetup:
npm run install:all
npm run dev

title: Smart Home Command Center
shortSummary: Control a simulated home, switch between rooms, and activate scenes.
problem: Control a simulated home, switch between rooms, and activate scenes.
architecture: The React simulation runs in the browser. A separate API workspace uses ASP.NET Core, EF Core and PostgreSQL.
decisions: Toggle a light or choose Movie Night, then check how the dashboard records the change.
highlights: Toggle a light or choose Movie Night, then check how the dashboard records the change.
outcome: Browser workflow checks passed in the handoff. Physical devices and a live PostgreSQL workflow remain unverified.
constraints: The examples use sample data and are designed for local review.

title: Voice to Code
shortSummary: Turn a typed or spoken instruction into a code snippet you can review and export.
problem: Turn a typed or spoken instruction into a code snippet you can review and export.
architecture: The browser UI offers sample generation and a separate live mode. The example workflow uses local sample output.
decisions: Choose Sort numbers, switch to TypeScript, generate the snippet, then copy or download it.
highlights: Choose Sort numbers, switch to TypeScript, generate the snippet, then copy or download it.
outcome: Browser checks exercised simulated speech and generation. Physical microphone capture and authenticated provider calls remain unverified.
constraints: The examples use sample data and are designed for local review.
